messages.subject: Acwa's next phase | Stakeholder execution across a 15-market growth platform
messages.body:
Dear Corporate Communications Team,

Please place this confidential executive note before Dr. Samir J. Serhan, Chief Executive Officer.

Your first message as CEO set a clear standard for Acwa's next phase: convert exceptional scale into sharper selectivity, stronger execution discipline and more resilient performance. With a global portfolio spanning power, water and green hydrogen across 15 markets, the operating challenge is increasingly about keeping project delivery, government relationships, environmental and social expectations and local stakeholder commitments aligned as growth accelerates.

That is where I see a credible contribution. Acwa's scale creates value only when country-level commitments remain connected to decision-making, risk ownership and delivery. A repeatable framework for institutional engagement, stakeholder mapping, ESG commitments, community interfaces and cross-functional escalation can strengthen execution across development, construction and operating assets, especially in emerging markets.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines senior government and regulator engagement, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, executive advisory and action closure across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage at a remote industrial operation.

I would value a conversation about where this operating-side experience might strengthen Acwa's country execution, stakeholder strategy, government relations, sustainability governance or strategic programs as the company enters its next phase of disciplined global growth. My attached CV has been prepared specifically around that contribution.

Kind regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
